LanguageData.WCIS_CommandDesc: See which items, prisoners, slaves and animals from your colony this settlement will buy, with estimated prices, and form a caravan with them pre-selected.
LanguageData.WCIS_NegotiatorTip: Estimated sell prices use this pawn's trade price improvement. The real price depends on who actually negotiates when the caravan arrives.
LanguageData.WCIS_SellPriceTip: Estimated price this trader pays per unit, using the chosen negotiator, the faction's price offset, and your difficulty settings.
LanguageData.WCIS_Nothing: Nothing here is wanted by this trader.
LanguageData.WCIS_NoColony: You have no colony map to sell from.
LanguageData.WCIS_ModeBuysTip: Things from your colony that {0} will buy.
LanguageData.WCIS_ModeWontBuyTip: Things {0} won't buy, and the nearest settlement that will.
LanguageData.WCIS_ElsewhereHint: Settlements nearby that buy what {0} won't. Click one to find it on the map.
LanguageData.WCIS_LookWithinTip: How far to look for other settlements, in tiles from your colony.
LanguageData.WCIS_BuyersTip: Settlements within {0} tiles that buy this:
LanguageData.WCIS_OpenBuyer: Click to show {0} on the world map.
LanguageData.WCIS_NothingElsewhere: No other settlement within {0} tiles buys anything this trader won't.
LanguageData.WCIS_HostileNoCaravan: This faction is hostile, so a caravan sent here would attack instead of trading.
LanguageData.WCIS_AutoSuppliesOff: Automatic travel supply selection was turned off so it won't overwrite the food or medicine you chose to sell. Add travel supplies manually.
